sources.name: background
sources.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Full-bleed portrait 4:5 hand-painted oil/gouache game puzzle background with rich natural textures, believable perspective and calm inviting detail. FULLY OPAQUE RGB painting: every pixel opaque, alpha255 everywhere, including edges; no transparency or black voids. Not a photo, vector, UI, collage or diagram. No text, digits, logos, famous landmarks or border. A complete coherent environment; leave only specified tiny later details absent and paint their natural anchor surfaces. Close cozy three-quarter view of a sheltered mangrove inlet with arching natural roots and calm water. GOLDEN YELLOW canopy leaves, warm yellow light and large golden water reflections must dominate most of composition; muted cocoa roots and green accents. A little canoe is moored far back, no person. Reserve clear calm water patches near center and lower-right for one ripple and one floating golden leaf; an exposed bare mangrove twig comfortably inside upper-left for a little leaf cluster; a thin bare reed root at near right shore for seed reeds; a clear warm air patch above water for one small dragonfly. Delicate fine roots, no fantasy shapes.

Invisible3x2 grid, five complete tiny objects in reading order, sixth lower-right empty. Whole objects within central280x300 of each512x512 cell with100px transparent gutters. No border, text, labels, drawn grid, backdrop or glow. Warm detailed oil/gouache brush texture, natural upper-left lighting. For a golden-yellow mangrove inlet: (1) thin translucent golden-ivory horizontal water ripple, no filled water patch; (2) a small golden oval mangrove leaf floating flat on water, slight wet rim, no ground; (3) a compact golden-green mangrove twig with three leaves and a bare cut stem at bottom, no roots; (4) two delicate golden reeds with pointed thin bases, no root ball; (5) one small blue-green dragonfly flying viewed obliquely, correct four transparent wings and slender body. Subtle natural details.
